decisions.reason: The accelerator program builds on the firm's recycling and advisory expertise and is still featured on the home page, so the firm can interpret results and keep refining it, though as a non-core service it remains somewhat at risk.
The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship that draws on the firm's material-conversion know-how and in-house R&D and still has its own page, which supports continued development.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's core machinery expertise, is highlighted as a flagship on the home page, and gains knowledge from the cooperation partnership, giving it high absorptive fit.
